gauntlet: done summary

### What is broken

Opening `/widgets/` shows page not found (404) instead of the widgets page.

### Why it is broken

The part that matches web addresses to pages compares them exactly, without removing a final slash. As a result, `/widgets/` fails to match the widgets page. A local attempt reproduced the failure, and a test confirmed the mismatch.

### How to fix it

Remove the final slash before comparing addresses so `/widgets/` reaches the widgets page. An existing ticket already covers this problem, so no new ticket was created and follow-up continues there ([ticket](https://github.com/example/widgets/issues/42)).
